LIMIT 1

input:
SELECT MAX(CAST(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / CAST(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL)) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / CAST(satscores.NumTstTakr AS REAL) > 0.3

output.sql:

WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / CAST(satscores.NumTstTakr AS REAL) > 0.3
